question: Who among the following denounced the injustice of the caste system and founded the Satyashodhak Samaj (Truth Seekers Society)
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jyotirao Goviudrao Phule.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jyotirao Goviudrao Phule**__, a member of the** Mali caste of farmers and gardeners**, was born on** April 11, 1827, in Maharashtra.**
